focus: 以外水壓、有效重量與施工階段判讀地下結構抗浮~Evaluate underground uplift through external water pressure, effective weight and construction stages

units.anchor: 外包排水體積~Displaced envelope volume
units.title: 外包排水體積~Displaced envelope volume
units.mechanism: 密閉地下箱體的總浮力來自周圍水壓在外表面的合力，不能只拿混凝土材料體積計算。模型先畫出水能到達的邊界，再辨別開口進水是否改變有效排水體積。取水重度γw=9.81kN/m³及外包排水體積V=500m³，U=γwV=4905kN；此處假設箱體封閉且完全浸沒，並非混凝土重量。若以混凝土量代替排水體積，空心箱體的上浮荷載會被低估；外水回升時可能先出現接縫張開、止水破壞，再發展成整體上浮。~Net buoyancy on a sealed underground box is the resultant of water pressure on its external surfaces. Concrete material volume alone is not the displaced volume. First draw the boundary accessible to water, then determine whether flooding through an opening changes that displacement. With water unit weight γw=9.81kN/m³ and displaced envelope V=500m³, U=γwV=4905kN. The box is assumed sealed and fully submerged; this is not concrete weight. Substituting concrete volume for displaced volume underestimates uplift on a hollow box; rising external water can open joints and damage waterstops before global flotation progressively develops.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：取水重度γw=9.81kN/m³及外包排水體積V=500m³，U=γwV=4905kN；此處假設箱體封閉且完全浸沒，並非混凝土重量。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With water unit weight γw=9.81kN/m³ and displaced envelope V=500m³, U=γwV=4905kN. The box is assumed sealed and fully submerged; this is not concrete weight.
units.verify: 以竣工幾何及防水分區建立外包體積表，並用水壓積分獨立重算浮力。比對設計水位與量測孔壓是否落在同一高程基準，確認結構工程師核定的水可達範圍。同時排除以下干擾原因：若以混凝土量代替排水體積，空心箱體的上浮荷載會被低估；外水回升時可能先出現接縫張開、止水破壞，再發展成整體上浮。~Build an envelope-volume schedule from geometry and waterproof compartments, then independently integrate pressures. Compare design water level and measured pore pressure on the same elevation datum and have the structural engineer confirm the wetted boundary. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Substituting concrete volume for displaced volume underestimates uplift on a hollow box; rising external water can open joints and damage waterstops before global flotation progressively develops.
units.failure: 若以混凝土量代替排水體積，空心箱體的上浮荷載會被低估；外水回升時可能先出現接縫張開、止水破壞，再發展成整體上浮。~Substituting concrete volume for displaced volume underestimates uplift on a hollow box; rising external water can open joints and damage waterstops before global flotation progressively develops.
units.misconception: 只要外包排水體積符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for displaced envelope volume removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接外包排水體積時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。以竣工幾何及防水分區建立外包體積表，並用水壓積分獨立重算浮力。比對設計水位與量測孔壓是否落在同一高程基準，確認結構工程師核定的水可達範圍。~When handing over displaced envelope volume, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Build an envelope-volume schedule from geometry and waterproof compartments, then independently integrate pressures. Compare design water level and measured pore pressure on the same elevation datum and have the structural engineer confirm the wetted boundary.

units.anchor: 基底水壓分布~Base water pressure
units.title: 基底水壓分布~Base water pressure
units.mechanism: 基底水壓由壓力水頭控制，排水管有出水不代表整片底板都處於零水壓。分層滲透與局部堵塞可形成不均勻抬升，總合力及偏心需分別核算。水頭h=8m且靜水條件下，p=γwh=9.81×8=78.48kPa，約78.5kPa；水頭須從底板外側所選測點起算。孔壓計濾頭若位在排水通道旁，讀值可偏低而掩蓋遠處高壓；平均水壓看似合理仍可能漏掉局部裂縫與板角翹起的控制區。~Base pressure follows pressure head. Visible discharge from one drain does not prove zero pressure beneath the entire slab. Layered permeability and local blockage can produce uneven uplift, requiring separate checks of resultant force and eccentricity. For h=8m under hydrostatic conditions, p=γwh=9.81×8=78.48kPa, about78.5kPa. Measure pressure head above the selected point on the external slab face. A sensor beside a drain can read low while remote pressure remains high; an apparently reasonable average can miss the locations controlling local cracking and corner uplift.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：水頭h=8m且靜水條件下，p=γwh=9.81×8=78.48kPa，約78.5kPa；水頭須從底板外側所選測點起算。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For h=8m under hydrostatic conditions, p=γwh=9.81×8=78.48kPa, about78.5kPa. Measure pressure head above the selected point on the external slab face.
units.verify: 在不同排水分區布置孔壓觀測，將每點高程轉為同一水頭再繪等壓圖。驗證孔壓計飽和、零點及量測時間，不能以單一集水井水位代替全底板壓力。同時排除以下干擾原因：孔壓計濾頭若位在排水通道旁，讀值可偏低而掩蓋遠處高壓；平均水壓看似合理仍可能漏掉局部裂縫與板角翹起的控制區。~Observe pore pressure across drainage zones and convert every elevation to a common head before mapping pressure. Check sensor saturation, zero and timing; one sump level cannot represent the full slab pressure field. Also rule out the following competing explanation: A sensor beside a drain can read low while remote pressure remains high; an apparently reasonable average can miss the locations controlling local cracking and corner uplift.
units.failure: 孔壓計濾頭若位在排水通道旁，讀值可偏低而掩蓋遠處高壓；平均水壓看似合理仍可能漏掉局部裂縫與板角翹起的控制區。~A sensor beside a drain can read low while remote pressure remains high; an apparently reasonable average can miss the locations controlling local cracking and corner uplift.

units.practice: 交接基底水壓分布時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。在不同排水分區布置孔壓觀測，將每點高程轉為同一水頭再繪等壓圖。驗證孔壓計飽和、零點及量測時間，不能以單一集水井水位代替全底板壓力。~When handing over base water pressure, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Observe pore pressure across drainage zones and convert every elevation to a common head before mapping pressure. Check sensor saturation, zero and timing; one sump level cannot represent the full slab pressure field.

units.anchor: 施工重量不足~Insufficient construction weight
units.title: 施工重量不足~Insufficient construction weight
units.mechanism: 抗浮不能只檢查完工樓板與覆土全部到位的狀態。開挖完成但上部結構尚輕時，外水恢復與停泵必須列為獨立施工階段，分清當時真正存在的永久重量。假設當期重量W=4000kN、浮力U=4905kN，未乘分項係數的比值W/U=0.815；小於1表示此理想平衡已不足，不能視為法規安全係數。將尚未施工的樓板重量提前計入，會在停電或提早停泵時失去抗浮儲備；即使最終設計足夠，施工期也可能發生不可逆接縫損傷。~A final-state check with every floor and cover layer installed does not establish construction stability. After excavation but before the superstructure gains weight, water recovery and pump shutdown require separate staged checks using only loads actually present. Assume current weight W=4000kN and uplift U=4905kN. The unfactored ratio W/U=0.815 is below unity, indicating deficient ideal equilibrium; it is not a code safety factor. Crediting future floor weight removes the apparent uplift reserve during an outage or premature shutdown; an adequate final design can still suffer irreversible joint damage during construction.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設當期重量W=4000kN、浮力U=4905kN，未乘分項係數的比值W/U=0.815；小於1表示此理想平衡已不足，不能視為法規安全係數。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: Assume current weight W=4000kN and uplift U=4905kN. The unfactored ratio W/U=0.815 is below unity, indicating deficient ideal equilibrium; it is not a code safety factor.
units.verify: 逐層核對已澆置體積、實際材料重度及可依賴的荷載，將養護、回填與停泵時點排列成施工表。責任工程師應依當期水位與分項設計重新核准轉換條件。同時排除以下干擾原因：將尚未施工的樓板重量提前計入，會在停電或提早停泵時失去抗浮儲備；即使最終設計足夠，施工期也可能發生不可逆接縫損傷。~Reconcile placed volumes, material unit weights and dependable loads for every stage. Schedule curing, backfill and pump shutdown, and require the responsible engineer to approve each transition using current water levels and factored design checks. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Crediting future floor weight removes the apparent uplift reserve during an outage or premature shutdown; an adequate final design can still suffer irreversible joint damage during construction.
units.failure: 將尚未施工的樓板重量提前計入，會在停電或提早停泵時失去抗浮儲備；即使最終設計足夠，施工期也可能發生不可逆接縫損傷。~Crediting future floor weight removes the apparent uplift reserve during an outage or premature shutdown; an adequate final design can still suffer irreversible joint damage during construction.
units.misconception: 只要施工重量不足符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for insufficient construction weight removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接施工重量不足時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。逐層核對已澆置體積、實際材料重度及可依賴的荷載，將養護、回填與停泵時點排列成施工表。責任工程師應依當期水位與分項設計重新核准轉換條件。~When handing over insufficient construction weight, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Reconcile placed volumes, material unit weights and dependable loads for every stage. Schedule curing, backfill and pump shutdown, and require the responsible engineer to approve each transition using current water levels and factored design checks.

units.anchor: 抗拔樁荷載分配~Tension pile distribution
units.title: 抗拔樁荷載分配~Tension pile distribution
units.mechanism: 抗拔樁把淨上浮力經底板接頭傳到樁身及周圍土層。平均分配只是剛度相近且幾何對稱時的第一輪估算，偏心、群樁互制及接頭延性不能由平均值證明。若U=6000kN、已存在重量W=4000kN且10支樁理想均分，T=(U−W)/10=200kN/樁；實際各樁須由相容變形與群樁分析確認。軟硬不均或樁頭鬆脫會讓鄰樁承受超過平均值的拉力；只看總樁數可能漏掉局部破壞，裂縫又會使防水失效並改變水壓條件。~Tension piles transfer net uplift through slab connections into the pile shafts and surrounding ground. Equal sharing is only an initial estimate for comparable stiffness and symmetric geometry; it does not establish eccentric response, group interaction or connection ductility. For U=6000kN, existing W=4000kN and ten ideally equal piles, T=(U−W)/10=200kN per pile. Actual forces require compatible deformations and group analysis. Unequal stiffness or a loose pile head can overload adjacent piles beyond the mean; total pile count conceals local failure, while cracking damages waterproofing and changes the pressure boundary.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：若U=6000kN、已存在重量W=4000kN且10支樁理想均分，T=(U−W)/10=200kN/樁；實際各樁須由相容變形與群樁分析確認。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For U=6000kN, existing W=4000kN and ten ideally equal piles, T=(U−W)/10=200kN per pile. Actual forces require compatible deformations and group analysis.
units.verify: 核對樁頭拉力傳遞細部與代表性抗拔試驗，將量測伸長及荷載分配和計算剛度比較。試驗方法、持荷與驗收門檻由設計及試驗工程師訂定，不以課程數值代替。同時排除以下干擾原因：軟硬不均或樁頭鬆脫會讓鄰樁承受超過平均值的拉力；只看總樁數可能漏掉局部破壞，裂縫又會使防水失效並改變水壓條件。~Review pile-head tension details and representative uplift tests. Compare measured elongation and force sharing with calculated stiffness; the design and testing engineers set the procedure, hold periods and acceptance limits rather than adopting course numbers. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Unequal stiffness or a loose pile head can overload adjacent piles beyond the mean; total pile count conceals local failure, while cracking damages waterproofing and changes the pressure boundary.

Review pile-head tension details and representative uplift tests. Compare measured elongation and force sharing with calculated stiffness; the design and testing engineers set the procedure, hold periods and acceptance limits rather than adopting course numbers.

units.anchor: 側壁摩阻動員~Side friction mobilization
units.title: 側壁摩阻動員~Side friction mobilization
units.mechanism: 側壁土體能否提供向下阻力取決於相對位移、界面及有效應力，不是接觸就自動產生全額抗力。回填鬆動、滑動層或防水保護膜都可能降低可動員的摩阻。假設已證明可動員的平均剪應力τ=15kPa、接觸面積A=100m²，R=τA=1500kN；尚未驗證的接觸面不可直接套此抗力。把極限摩阻當作零位移即可使用的反力，會隱藏服務性失效；結構必須上浮後才得到阻力，屆時密封接縫可能已經拉開而不能恢復。~Downward side resistance depends on relative movement, interface properties and effective stress, rather than contact alone. Loose backfill, slip layers or waterproofing protection sheets may reduce the resistance that can actually be mobilized. If mobilizable average shear stress τ=15kPa is demonstrated over A=100m², R=τA=1500kN. An unverified interface must not automatically receive this resistance. Treating ultimate friction as a zero-movement reaction hides serviceability failure; sufficient uplift may be needed to mobilize resistance only after sealing joints have opened irreversibly.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設已證明可動員的平均剪應力τ=15kPa、接觸面積A=100m²，R=τA=1500kN；尚未驗證的接觸面不可直接套此抗力。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If mobilizable average shear stress τ=15kPa is demonstrated over A=100m², R=τA=1500kN. An unverified interface must not automatically receive this resistance.
units.verify: 查驗界面材料與施工回填紀錄，將剪切試驗條件和現地有效應力比較。另列達到假設摩阻所需位移，檢查該位移是否已超過止水與鄰接管線容許變形。同時排除以下干擾原因：把極限摩阻當作零位移即可使用的反力，會隱藏服務性失效；結構必須上浮後才得到阻力，屆時密封接縫可能已經拉開而不能恢復。~Inspect interface materials and backfill records, comparing shear-test conditions with field effective stress. State the movement required to mobilize resistance and check whether it already exceeds waterstop or connected-pipe deformation limits. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Treating ultimate friction as a zero-movement reaction hides serviceability failure; sufficient uplift may be needed to mobilize resistance only after sealing joints have opened irreversibly.

Inspect interface materials and backfill records, comparing shear-test conditions with field effective stress. State the movement required to mobilize resistance and check whether it already exceeds waterstop or connected-pipe deformation limits.

units.anchor: 排水失效增量~Drainage failure increment
units.title: 排水失效增量~Drainage failure increment
units.mechanism: 抽排系統降低作用水頭，但電力、濾層與排放路徑是會退化的外部條件。抗浮評估應把排水正常與失效分列，並追蹤水位恢復速度，而非只記泵浦額定流量。此處研究底板下表面水壓，須假設上表面乾燥或壓力固定；完全浸沒封閉箱體還有頂面向下水壓，淨浮力不能只取底面增量。假設均勻增加水頭Δh=3m、底面A=200m²，ΔU=γwAΔh=9.81×200×3=5886kN；此為底板上表面乾燥或壓力固定時的上浮合力增量；不適用於外包體積固定且完全浸沒封閉箱體的淨浮力，後者仍為γwV。流量下降可能表示水源減少，也可能是濾層堵塞；若誤判成環境變乾而取消備援，水壓可在無出水的情況下升高並危及整體穩定。~Pumping reduces head but depends on power, filters and discharge paths that can deteriorate. Evaluate normal drainage separately from failure, tracking water-level recovery rather than treating a pump nameplate flow as proof of uplift control. Here the lower slab-face pressure is studied with the upper face dry or held at fixed pressure; a fully submerged sealed box also gains downward roof pressure, so its net buoyancy cannot be obtained from the bottom increment alone. For uniform Δh=3m over A=200m², ΔU=γwAΔh=5886kN assumes the upper slab face remains dry or at fixed pressure. A sealed, fully submerged box of fixed volume retains net buoyancy γwV instead. Reduced flow can mean less recharge or a blocked filter. Mistaking blockage for drying can remove backup capacity while hidden pressure rises despite little discharge and threatens global stability.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設均勻增加水頭Δh=3m、底面A=200m²，ΔU=γwAΔh=9.81×200×3=5886kN；此為底板上表面乾燥或壓力固定時的上浮合力增量；不適用於外包體積固定且完全浸沒封閉箱體的淨浮力，後者仍為γwV。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For uniform Δh=3m over A=200m², ΔU=γwAΔh=5886kN assumes the upper slab face remains dry or at fixed pressure. A sealed, fully submerged box of fixed volume retains net buoyancy γwV instead.
units.verify: 以受控情境分析比較備援供電、排水堵塞及高外水位的孔壓反應，檢查警報傳遞與值班回應時間。任何停泵試驗須經工程師批准並配有獨立監測與停止條件。同時排除以下干擾原因：流量下降可能表示水源減少，也可能是濾層堵塞；若誤判成環境變乾而取消備援，水壓可在無出水的情況下升高並危及整體穩定。~Use controlled scenario analysis to compare backup-power failure, blockage and high external water. Check alarm delivery and response times; any shutdown test needs engineering approval, independent monitoring and defined stop conditions. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Reduced flow can mean less recharge or a blocked filter. Mistaking blockage for drying can remove backup capacity while hidden pressure rises despite little discharge and threatens global stability.
units.failure: 流量下降可能表示水源減少，也可能是濾層堵塞；若誤判成環境變乾而取消備援，水壓可在無出水的情況下升高並危及整體穩定。~Reduced flow can mean less recharge or a blocked filter. Mistaking blockage for drying can remove backup capacity while hidden pressure rises despite little discharge and threatens global stability.
units.misconception: 只要排水失效增量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for drainage failure increment removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接排水失效增量時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。以受控情境分析比較備援供電、排水堵塞及高外水位的孔壓反應，檢查警報傳遞與值班回應時間。任何停泵試驗須經工程師批准並配有獨立監測與停止條件。~When handing over drainage failure increment, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Use controlled scenario analysis to compare backup-power failure, blockage and high external water. Check alarm delivery and response times; any shutdown test needs engineering approval, independent monitoring and defined stop conditions.

units.anchor: 底板局部彎曲~Local slab bending
units.title: 底板局部彎曲~Local slab bending
units.mechanism: 整體重量足以抵抗浮力仍不代表底板每一跨可承受局部水壓。簡支單向帶模型用於辨識彎矩量級，實際雙向配筋、支承剛度及裂縫寬度需要另外設計。取淨上向壓力p=80kPa、跨L=4m與1m板帶，線荷載w=80kN/m，M=wL²/8=160kN·m每米板寬；簡支假設不含連續板負彎矩。若把上向水壓照抄成下向重力的配筋方向，受拉面可能缺筋；總抗浮比值仍正常時，跨中或支承裂縫已可形成滲流通道並降低耐久性。~Global resistance to buoyancy does not prove that every slab span resists local pressure. A simply supported one-way strip estimates moment scale; actual two-way reinforcement, support stiffness and crack width require separate design. For net upward p=80kPa, span L=4m and a one-metre strip, w=80kN/m and M=wL²/8=160kN·m per metre width. Simple supports omit continuity moments. Copying reinforcement orientation from downward gravity loading can leave the uplift tension face deficient. Even with adequate global equilibrium, support or midspan cracks can admit water and reduce durability.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：取淨上向壓力p=80kPa、跨L=4m與1m板帶，線荷載w=80kN/m，M=wL²/8=160kN·m每米板寬；簡支假設不含連續板負彎矩。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For net upward p=80kPa, span L=4m and a one-metre strip, w=80kN/m and M=wL²/8=160kN·m per metre width. Simple supports omit continuity moments.
units.verify: 對照底板跨距、樁柱位置與實際支承條件畫出彎矩圖，再核對上下層鋼筋與接頭錨定。裂縫量測須記錄水位，讓服務性驗證與荷載狀態相互對應。同時排除以下干擾原因：若把上向水壓照抄成下向重力的配筋方向，受拉面可能缺筋；總抗浮比值仍正常時，跨中或支承裂縫已可形成滲流通道並降低耐久性。~Draw moments using actual spans, pile and column locations and support conditions. Check reinforcement on both faces and anchorage; record water level alongside crack measurements so serviceability observations correspond to the applied load. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Copying reinforcement orientation from downward gravity loading can leave the uplift tension face deficient. Even with adequate global equilibrium, support or midspan cracks can admit water and reduce durability.
units.failure: 若把上向水壓照抄成下向重力的配筋方向，受拉面可能缺筋；總抗浮比值仍正常時，跨中或支承裂縫已可形成滲流通道並降低耐久性。~Copying reinforcement orientation from downward gravity loading can leave the uplift tension face deficient. Even with adequate global equilibrium, support or midspan cracks can admit water and reduce durability.
units.misconception: 只要底板局部彎曲符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for local slab bending removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接底板局部彎曲時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。對照底板跨距、樁柱位置與實際支承條件畫出彎矩圖，再核對上下層鋼筋與接頭錨定。裂縫量測須記錄水位，讓服務性驗證與荷載狀態相互對應。~When handing over local slab bending, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Draw moments using actual spans, pile and column locations and support conditions. Check reinforcement on both faces and anchorage; record water level alongside crack measurements so serviceability observations correspond to the applied load.

units.anchor: 偏心水壓力矩~Eccentric uplift moment
units.title: 偏心水壓力矩~Eccentric uplift moment
units.mechanism: 不均勻水壓讓合力偏離重量中心，帶來轉動及樁頭拉力差。計算總浮力時必須保留作用位置，不能把分區孔壓平均後就丟掉偏心資訊。若浮力U=5000kN偏心e=0.5m，附加力矩M=Ue=2500kN·m；它必須與重量、支承反力在同一參考點取矩平衡。只將合力除以總面積會掩蓋一側先離地的情境；隨支承接觸消失，原本假設的反力分配失效，接縫張開與樁力集中會彼此加劇。~Uneven pressure displaces the uplift resultant from the centre of gravity and creates rotation and unequal pile forces. Preserve load locations when summing uplift; averaging compartment pressures must not erase their eccentricity. If U=5000kN acts at eccentricity e=0.5m, M=Ue=2500kN·m. Balance it with weight and support reactions about the same reference point. Dividing total uplift by total area conceals early separation on one side; losing contact invalidates assumed reactions, allowing joint opening and concentrated pile tension to reinforce each other.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：若浮力U=5000kN偏心e=0.5m，附加力矩M=Ue=2500kN·m；它必須與重量、支承反力在同一參考點取矩平衡。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If U=5000kN acts at eccentricity e=0.5m, M=Ue=2500kN·m. Balance it with weight and support reactions about the same reference point.
units.verify: 將孔壓分區合力與坐標同時輸入自由體圖，用測量儀與傾度計比較板面變形方向。若模型預測和轉動相反，先查感測器高程、分區連通及重量偏心。同時排除以下干擾原因：只將合力除以總面積會掩蓋一側先離地的情境；隨支承接觸消失，原本假設的反力分配失效，接縫張開與樁力集中會彼此加劇。~Enter pressure-zone forces and coordinates together in a free-body diagram. Compare predicted rotation with survey and tilt observations; opposite trends warrant checking sensor elevations, hydraulic connections and eccentric structural weight. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Dividing total uplift by total area conceals early separation on one side; losing contact invalidates assumed reactions, allowing joint opening and concentrated pile tension to reinforce each other.
units.failure: 只將合力除以總面積會掩蓋一側先離地的情境；隨支承接觸消失，原本假設的反力分配失效，接縫張開與樁力集中會彼此加劇。~Dividing total uplift by total area conceals early separation on one side; losing contact invalidates assumed reactions, allowing joint opening and concentrated pile tension to reinforce each other.
units.misconception: 只要偏心水壓力矩符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for eccentric uplift moment removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接偏心水壓力矩時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。將孔壓分區合力與坐標同時輸入自由體圖，用測量儀與傾度計比較板面變形方向。若模型預測和轉動相反，先查感測器高程、分區連通及重量偏心。~When handing over eccentric uplift moment, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Enter pressure-zone forces and coordinates together in a free-body diagram. Compare predicted rotation with survey and tilt observations; opposite trends warrant checking sensor elevations, hydraulic connections and eccentric structural weight.

units.title: 水位敏感度~Water level sensitivity
units.mechanism: 維護期的抗浮警報應連結水位對荷載的敏感度，而不只使用固定高程。均勻底板面積提供簡單斜率，若淹水邊界或排水分區改變，須重新建立作用面積。此斜率是底板下表面水壓對固定上表面壓力的合力增量；完全浸沒封閉箱體的頂面水壓增量須另計。取A=300m²且作用面積固定，dU/dh=γwA=9.81×300=2943kN/m；假設底板上表面乾燥或壓力固定，水位每增加1m，底板上浮合力增加2943kN；固定體積完全浸沒封閉箱體的淨浮力γwV不隨此水位上升增加。若新增鄰近抽水或外部回填改變水流卻仍沿用舊斜率，警報可能無法代表現況；高解析度感測器也不能修正錯誤的有效面積與水力邊界。~Operational alarms should reflect the sensitivity of load to water level rather than relying only on a fixed elevation. A uniform footprint gives a simple slope; changing inundation or drainage boundaries requires an updated effective area. This slope describes the lower slab-face force relative to a fixed upper-face pressure; a fully submerged sealed box also requires the roof-pressure increment. With fixed A=300m², dU/dh=γwA=9.81×300=2943kN/m. Assuming the upper slab face is dry or at fixed pressure, a one-metre rise adds2943kN to slab uplift. Net buoyancy γwV of a fully submerged sealed box of fixed volume does not increase with this water-level rise. Nearby pumping or backfill can alter flow while an old slope remains in use; even a high-resolution sensor cannot correct the wrong effective area or hydraulic boundary in an outdated alarm model.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：取A=300m²且作用面積固定，dU/dh=γwA=9.81×300=2943kN/m；假設底板上表面乾燥或壓力固定，水位每增加1m，底板上浮合力增加2943kN；固定體積完全浸沒封閉箱體的淨浮力γwV不隨此水位上升增加。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With fixed A=300m², dU/dh=γwA=9.81×300=2943kN/m. Assuming the upper slab face is dry or at fixed pressure, a one-metre rise adds2943kN to slab uplift. Net buoyancy γwV of a fully submerged sealed box of fixed volume does not increase with this water-level rise.
units.verify: 以季節水位紀錄估計合理變動範圍，將量測不確定性乘上敏感度得到荷載誤差。由維護與設計負責人共同訂警戒層級及回應時限，保存每次修改理由。同時排除以下干擾原因：若新增鄰近抽水或外部回填改變水流卻仍沿用舊斜率，警報可能無法代表現況；高解析度感測器也不能修正錯誤的有效面積與水力邊界。~Estimate credible variations from seasonal records and multiply level uncertainty by sensitivity to obtain force uncertainty. Maintenance and design leads should jointly set alarm levels and response times, retaining the rationale for each change. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Nearby pumping or backfill can alter flow while an old slope remains in use; even a high-resolution sensor cannot correct the wrong effective area or hydraulic boundary in an outdated alarm model.
units.failure: 若新增鄰近抽水或外部回填改變水流卻仍沿用舊斜率，警報可能無法代表現況；高解析度感測器也不能修正錯誤的有效面積與水力邊界。~Nearby pumping or backfill can alter flow while an old slope remains in use; even a high-resolution sensor cannot correct the wrong effective area or hydraulic boundary in an outdated alarm model.
units.misconception: 只要水位敏感度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for water level sensitivity removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接水位敏感度時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。以季節水位紀錄估計合理變動範圍，將量測不確定性乘上敏感度得到荷載誤差。由維護與設計負責人共同訂警戒層級及回應時限，保存每次修改理由。~When handing over water level sensitivity, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Estimate credible variations from seasonal records and multiply level uncertainty by sensitivity to obtain force uncertainty. Maintenance and design leads should jointly set alarm levels and response times, retaining the rationale for each change.

units.anchor: 抗浮證據交接~Uplift evidence handover
units.title: 抗浮證據交接~Uplift evidence handover
units.mechanism: 交接要同時保存永久重量、可動員抗力及高水位情境，讓維護者知道哪些能力依賴機械排水。抗力不得重複計入，例如同一土塊重量與同一滑面摩阻需核對相容機制。假設同一可相容工況W=7000kN、額外抗力R=1000kN、U=7500kN，未分項餘量W+R−U=500kN；正餘量本身不等於通過所有規範。把設計圖上的抗力視為永久不變會忽略腐蝕、蠕變及排水堵塞；若責任移交未包含高水位情境，維護者可能在不知情下改變穩定機制。~Handover must preserve dependable weight, mobilizable resistance and high-water scenarios so operators know which capacity relies on pumping. Avoid double counting, for example when the same soil mass and interface resistance participate in incompatible mechanisms. For one compatible scenario with W=7000kN, additional R=1000kN and U=7500kN, the unfactored margin W+R−U=500kN. A positive margin alone is not full code compliance. Treating drawing capacities as permanent ignores corrosion, creep and blocked drains; omitting high-water scenarios from handover lets operators unknowingly alter the mechanism that maintains stability.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設同一可相容工況W=7000kN、額外抗力R=1000kN、U=7500kN，未分項餘量W+R−U=500kN；正餘量本身不等於通過所有規範。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For one compatible scenario with W=7000kN, additional R=1000kN and U=7500kN, the unfactored margin W+R−U=500kN. A positive margin alone is not full code compliance.
units.verify: 用交接清單逐項核對計算版本、孔壓基準、抗拔試驗、排水維護責任及緊急聯絡程序。缺少任一控制抗力的證據時，主管工程師應重新界定可接受的使用情境。同時排除以下干擾原因：把設計圖上的抗力視為永久不變會忽略腐蝕、蠕變及排水堵塞；若責任移交未包含高水位情境，維護者可能在不知情下改變穩定機制。~Reconcile calculation versions, pressure datums, uplift tests, drainage responsibilities and emergency contacts. If evidence for a controlling resistance is missing, the responsible engineer must redefine the acceptable operating scenarios before handover. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Treating drawing capacities as permanent ignores corrosion, creep and blocked drains; omitting high-water scenarios from handover lets operators unknowingly alter the mechanism that maintains stability.
units.failure: 把設計圖上的抗力視為永久不變會忽略腐蝕、蠕變及排水堵塞；若責任移交未包含高水位情境，維護者可能在不知情下改變穩定機制。~Treating drawing capacities as permanent ignores corrosion, creep and blocked drains; omitting high-water scenarios from handover lets operators unknowingly alter the mechanism that maintains stability.
units.misconception: 只要抗浮證據交接符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for uplift evidence handover removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接抗浮證據交接時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。用交接清單逐項核對計算版本、孔壓基準、抗拔試驗、排水維護責任及緊急聯絡程序。缺少任一控制抗力的證據時，主管工程師應重新界定可接受的使用情境。~When handing over uplift evidence handover, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Reconcile calculation versions, pressure datums, uplift tests, drainage responsibilities and emergency contacts. If evidence for a controlling resistance is missing, the responsible engineer must redefine the acceptable operating scenarios before handover.

title: 地下結構浮力穩定~Uplift stability of underground structures
summary: 本課聚焦以外水壓、有效重量與施工階段判讀地下結構抗浮。十個單元依序辨識作用機制、量化假設、驗證程序與故障徵兆，讓學徒追蹤從原始資料到工程判斷的每一環。每個算例都帶單位與限制，不把局部成功或單一比值當成完整系統合格。交接須保留基準、異常與權責工程師核准的條件。~This course focuses on evaluate underground uplift through external water pressure, effective weight and construction stages. Ten units connect mechanisms, numerical assumptions, verification procedures and failure symptoms so apprentices can trace each inference from evidence to judgment. Every example includes units and limitations; one successful observation or ratio does not establish system acceptance. Handover retains datums, anomalies and conditions approved by the responsible engineer.
example: 以下為原創教學算例，所有輸入均為假設，不是地標實測。教學假設，非現場設定值：取水重度γw=9.81kN/m³及外包排水體積V=500m³，U=γwV=4905kN；此處假設箱體封閉且完全浸沒，並非混凝土重量。假設外包排水體積由500增為550m³而保持水重度9.81kN/m³，浮力由4905增為5395.5kN，增加490.5kN即10%；內部混凝土體積未參與這個體積替換。先列出符號、單位及固定條件，再以獨立計算器核算。敏感度只描述這個模型中的輸入改變；若邊界或物理機制改變，應重建模型而非線性外推。最後把計算值、量測不確定性及需進一步驗證的項目分列，由責任工程師決定能否支持下一階段。~The following original example uses assumptions rather than landmark measurements. Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With water unit weight γw=9.81kN/m³ and displaced envelope V=500m³, U=γwV=4905kN. The box is assumed sealed and fully submerged; this is not concrete weight. Increasing assumed displaced envelope volume from500 to550m³ at9.81kN/m³ changes uplift from4905 to5395.5kN, an increase of490.5kN or10%; internal concrete volume is not the displaced-volume input. First tabulate symbols, units and fixed conditions, then check the arithmetic independently. Sensitivity describes an input change inside this model only. Changed boundaries or physical mechanisms require a new model rather than linear extrapolation. Finally distinguish the calculated result, measurement uncertainty and evidence still needed; the responsible engineer decides whether the conclusion supports a next stage.
history: 本課以公開工程研究與機構文件建立以外水壓、有效重量與施工階段判讀地下結構抗浮的背景。美國聯邦公路管理局出版隧道土建手冊（2009）。香港場地勘察指南與Crossrail地質資料更新（2017）。香港擋土牆指南列出持續更新版本（2020）。兩個地標用來比較環境、量測與維護證據，並非宣稱本課每一教學構件都實際用於兩處。來源若只可讀摘要，適用範圍已另行註明；現場設計須重新確認規範版本與責任。本課只重建公開原理。~This course uses public research and institutional documents to establish context for evaluate underground uplift through external water pressure, effective weight and construction stages. FHWA publishes its civil-elements road-tunnel manual (2009). Hong Kong site-investigation guidance and Crossrail geological information are updated (2017). Hong Kong lists an updated retaining-wall design guide (2020). The two landmarks compare environments, measurements and maintenance evidence; they do not imply that every teaching component was installed at both sites. Abstract-only access is declared in source scopes. Field design requires current applicability and responsible review. This course reconstructs public principles only.
facts: 教學假設，非現場設定值：取水重度γw=9.81kN/m³及外包排水體積V=500m³，U=γwV=4905kN；此處假設箱體封閉且完全浸沒，並非混凝土重量。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With water unit weight γw=9.81kN/m³ and displaced envelope V=500m³, U=γwV=4905kN. The box is assumed sealed and fully submerged; this is not concrete weight.

教學假設，非現場設定值：水頭h=8m且靜水條件下，p=γwh=9.81×8=78.48kPa，約78.5kPa；水頭須從底板外側所選測點起算。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For h=8m under hydrostatic conditions, p=γwh=9.81×8=78.48kPa, about78.5kPa. Measure pressure head above the selected point on the external slab face.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設當期重量W=4000kN、浮力U=4905kN，未乘分項係數的比值W/U=0.815；小於1表示此理想平衡已不足，不能視為法規安全係數。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: Assume current weight W=4000kN and uplift U=4905kN. The unfactored ratio W/U=0.815 is below unity, indicating deficient ideal equilibrium; it is not a code safety factor.

教學假設，非現場設定值：若U=6000kN、已存在重量W=4000kN且10支樁理想均分，T=(U−W)/10=200kN/樁；實際各樁須由相容變形與群樁分析確認。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For U=6000kN, existing W=4000kN and ten ideally equal piles, T=(U−W)/10=200kN per pile. Actual forces require compatible deformations and group analysis.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設已證明可動員的平均剪應力τ=15kPa、接觸面積A=100m²，R=τA=1500kN；尚未驗證的接觸面不可直接套此抗力。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If mobilizable average shear stress τ=15kPa is demonstrated over A=100m², R=τA=1500kN. An unverified interface must not automatically receive this resistance.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設均勻增加水頭Δh=3m、底面A=200m²，ΔU=γwAΔh=9.81×200×3=5886kN；此為底板上表面乾燥或壓力固定時的上浮合力增量；不適用於外包體積固定且完全浸沒封閉箱體的淨浮力，後者仍為γwV。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For uniform Δh=3m over A=200m², ΔU=γwAΔh=5886kN assumes the upper slab face remains dry or at fixed pressure. A sealed, fully submerged box of fixed volume retains net buoyancy γwV instead.
